name: Jev
description: TypeSafe's Jev decision model on api.typesafe.ai. Instead of chat, send a piece of text (the state) plus named questions — yes/no (noul), pick-one (choice) or graded (score) — and get calibrated, typed answers with probabilities. Built for classification, routing, triage and scoring. Bearer-token auth.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Your TypeSafe API key — create one at https://console.typesafe.ai/keys

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask Jev one or more questions about a piece of content via POST /systemone. Put the content in `state` and the questions in `questions`, keyed by names you choose; answers come back under the same keys in `answers`. Question types: noul = yes/no, answer `noul` is a 0–1 probability that the statement is true; choice = pick one of the `criteria` keys, answer has `choice`, `confidence` and `probabilities`; score = `criteria` is an ordered list of levels (index 0 upward, max 10), answer `score` is the probability-weighted level and may be fractional. Batch several questions in one call: billing is per input token only. Default context is 64k tokens per request and 32k per question.

model.description: Model name or alias. Use jev-latest unless pinning a version (e.g. jev-1.14.0). Call list_models for the aliases.

state.description: The content every question refers to: a string, a JSON object, or an array of text values. Text only.

questions.description: At least one question, keyed by a name you choose. Example: {"is_urgent": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "The message conveys urgency"}, "department": {"type": "choice", "criteria": {"billing": "Payment issues", "technical": "Bugs or integration problems"}}, "frustration": {"type": "score", "criteria": ["Calm", "Frustrated but civil", "Very angry"]}}

type.description: noul = yes/no probability; choice = pick one option; score = graded level.

instructions.description: What to judge. For noul, the statement whose truth is estimated. String, object or array.

criteria.description: choice: REQUIRED object mapping each option name to its description (1–255 options). score: REQUIRED array of level descriptions, lowest first (1–10 levels). noul: optional {"true": ..., "false": ...} descriptions.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the Jev model aliases available via GET /models (name, description, release_date).
